comment: There are only three CHK switches for four slots: each one chokes the slot to its right, so the last slot has none. A slot whose TRG jack is empty is short-circuited to 0V at Drummer4.cpp:127 and the matching lines in the other three slots, which is why the module is silent before anything is patched. The output chaining works by carrying a running sum forward whenever an output is found unconnected.
